verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Skills as reusable instruction and knowledge packs that teach agents how to do a task. That is not the same as composable sub-workflows or modules that one workflow calls from another. Nothing in the pack documents a sub-workflow node, workflow-calls-workflow, or agent-calls-agent composition, so Skills, hosted MCP servers and SDK calls count only as adjacent features or building blocks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
